definitions.gloss: person who knows a lot; walking encyclopedia
definitions.explanation: Someone with a wide general knowledge of many things, often everyday or miscellaneous facts. Used as a noun ({物知|ものし}りな{人|ひと}, {彼|かれ}は{物知|ものし}りだ) and, with な, to describe the person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{物知|ものし}りだ。
examples.english: My grandfather knows a lot about everything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物知|ものし}りです⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: She really is well informed, isn't she.

examples.japanese: ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{物知|ものし}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}けば→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦たいてい→たいてい：01129_taitei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わかる。
examples.english: If you ask the most knowledgeable kid in the class, you can find out most things.

notes:
Usually a compliment. {物知|ものし}り{顔|がお} (a know-it-all look) and {物知|ものし}りぶる (to act knowledgeable) are the critical uses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物知|ものし}りな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a knowledgeable person
- {物知|ものし}り⟦{博士|はかせ}→博士：03551_hakase⟧: a walking encyclopedia (playful)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{博識|はくしき}→博識：21871_hakushiki⟧: erudition — formal, for scholarly learning
- ⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧: knowledgeable about one particular subject
- ⟦{知|し}ったかぶり→知ったかぶり：33948_shittakaburi⟧: pretending to know — the opposite of the real thing
